title: GTA 6 Miami Marketing Turns Real Life into Vice City
description: GTA 6 is going all-out with a massive marketing campaign in Miami, Florida, turning the real city into Vice City ahead of its November 19, 2026 release.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Miami Marketing Turns Real Life into Vice City

Vice City is real now. With an outrageous marketing push behind it, GTA 6 is clearly shaping up to be absolutely massive when it arrives next month.

The hotly anticipated open-world action game is scheduled for release on 19th November, 2026. Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two are going all-out with a marketing campaign that is gradually overtaking Miami, Florida, transforming it into a real-life Vice City through striking vehicle appearances and immersive promotional efforts.

### The Road to November 2026

As the launch date approaches, the scale of the marketing campaign highlights the enormous scope of the title. By bringing game-inspired elements directly into the streets of Miami, the publishers are capturing the attention of both long-time fans and mainstream audiences alike, setting the stage for what promises to be one of the biggest entertainment launches in history.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar Games and Take-Two know how to command global attention. Bringing the aesthetic of Vice City to the streets of Miami is a brilliant way to blur the lines between fiction and reality, ramping up the hype to astronomical levels ahead of November 19.
